_meta.note: Re-audit of the S289 sources. AA embedded objects: Openness Index, TB 2.1 / tau-Banking / GPQA / AIME25 / IFBench / tau2 Telecom / TB Hard / LCB as AA-run ids (legacy evals, models released >= 2025-10 only), TB-Science AA per-domain, MLCR sub-scores, Omniscience per-domain index, GDP.pdf criterion pass rates, Analyst Agent, APEX-Agents, EnterpriseOpsGym. OpenAI page: Opus 5.5 effort tiers (with fallback) on GDP.pdf / AutomationBench, Fable 5.1 AutomationBench score. GPT-6.1 Sol card: comparison-model figure labels (Fig 8/9/10/13/29/34/35), Fig 12 category breakdown, Fig 14 awareness-free subset, prose comparisons. Fill-missing only.
